Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

- name: Harden CentOS 9 server
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure this playbook runs on CentOS/RHEL 9 family
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"
          - ansible_facts['distribution_major_version'] is version('9', '==')
        fail_msg: "This playbook is intended for CentOS/RHEL 9 only."

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages are installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - epel-release
          - libpwquality
          - audit
          - fail2ban
          - firewalld
        state: present

    - name: Ensure firewalld is enabled and running (required for fail2ban firewall actions)
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: firewalld
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Harden SSH - create drop-in directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Harden SSH - disable root login and apply secure defaults
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-hardening.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0600'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Ansible managed: SSH hardening
          PermitRootLogin no
          Protocol 2
          UsePAM yes
          X11Forwarding no
          ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
          PermitEmptyPasswords no
          LoginGraceTime 30
          MaxAuthTries 5
          ClientAliveInterval 300
          ClientAliveCountMax 2
      notify: Reload sshd

    - name: Enforce password complexity - update pwquality.conf
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        regexp: '^(#\s*)?{{ item.key }}\s*='
        line: "{{ item.key }} = {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
        create: false
        backrefs: false
        backup: true
      loop:
        - { key: 'minlen', value: '14' }
        - { key: 'minclass', value: '3' }
        - { key: 'dcredit', value: '-1' }
        - { key: 'ucredit', value: '-1' }
        - { key: 'lcredit', value: '-1' }
        - { key: 'ocredit', value: '-1' }
        - { key: 'maxrepeat', value: '3' }
        - { key: 'maxclassrepeat', value: '4' }
        - { key: 'retry', value: '3' }
        - { key: 'dictcheck', value: '1' }
        - { key: 'gecoscheck', value: '1' }

    - name: Check current authselect configuration
      ansible.builtin.command: authselect current
      register: authselect_current
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Select authselect 'sssd' profile if none is configured
      ansible.builtin.command: authselect select sssd --force
      when: authselect_current.rc != 0
      register: authselect_select_sssd
      changed_when: authselect_select_sssd.rc == 0

    - name: Enable authselect 'with-pwquality' feature
      ansible.builtin.command: authselect enable-feature with-pwquality
      when: authselect_current.rc != 0 or ('with-pwquality' not in authselect_current.stdout)
      register: authselect_enable_pwq
      changed_when: authselect_enable_pwq.rc == 0

    - name: Apply authselect changes
      ansible.builtin.command: authselect apply-changes -b
      when: authselect_select_sssd is changed or authselect_enable_pwq is changed

    - name: Configure fail2ban defaults and enable sshd jail
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Ansible managed: fail2ban configuration
          [DEFAULT]
          backend = systemd
          banaction = firewallcmd-rich-rules
          bantime = 1h
          findtime = 10m
          maxretry = 5
          ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1

          [sshd]
          enabled = true
          port = ssh
          logpath = %(sshd_log)s
      notify: Restart fail2ban

    - name: Ensure fail2ban is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: fail2ban
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Configure auditd - auditd.conf
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: '^(#\s*)?{{ item.key }}\s*='
        line: "{{ item.key }} = {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
        backrefs: false
        backup: true
      loop:
        - { key: 'local_events', value: 'yes' }
        - { key: 'write_logs', value: 'yes' }
        - { key: 'log_file', value: '/var/log/audit/audit.log' }
        - { key: 'log_group', value: 'root' }
        - { key: 'flush', value: 'incremental_async' }
        - { key: 'freq', value: '50' }
        - { key: 'num_logs', value: '10' }
        - { key: 'max_log_file', value: '50' }
        - { key: 'max_log_file_action', value: 'rotate' }
        - { key: 'space_left', value: '25%' }
        - { key: 'admin_space_left', value: '10%' }
        - { key: 'space_left_action', value: 'SYSLOG' }
        - { key: 'admin_space_left_action', value: 'SUSPEND' }
        - { key: 'disk_full_action', value: 'SUSPEND' }
        - { key: 'disk_error_action', value: 'SUSPEND' }
        - { key: 'name_format', value: 'HOSTNAME' }
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Deploy comprehensive audit rules
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/10-hardening.rules
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Ansible managed: auditd hardening rules

          ## Time change monitoring
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S clock_settime -k time-change
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S clock_settime -k time-change
          -w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change

          ## Identity files monitoring
          -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/security/opasswd -p wa -k identity

          ## Sudo and privilege escalation
          -w /bin/su -p x -k priv_esc
          -w /usr/bin/sudo -p x -k priv_esc
          -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k priv_esc
          -w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k priv_esc

          ## Login/logout events
          -w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k logins

          ## Network/system identification
          -w /etc/issue -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/issue.net -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/hosts -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/sysconfig/network -p wa -k system-locale

          ## MAC policy changes (SELinux)
          -w /usr/share/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy

          ## Kernel module loading/unloading
          -w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules

          ## Unsuccessful file access (permission denied)
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EPERM -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EPERM -k access

          ## Permission and ownership changes by regular users
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod

          ## Ensure auditing is enabled
          -e 1
      notify:
        - Load audit rules
        - Restart auditd

    - name: Ensure auditd is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: Reload sshd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: reloaded

    - name: Restart fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: Load audit rules
      ansible.builtin.command: augenrules --load

    - name: Restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted

        - { key: 'disk_error_action', value: 'SUSPEND' }
        - { key: 'name_format', value: 'HOSTNAME' }
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Deploy comprehensive audit rules
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/10-hardening.rules
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Ansible managed: auditd hardening rules

          ## Time change monitoring
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S clock_settime -k time-change
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S clock_settime -k time-change
          -w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change

          ## Identity files monitoring
          -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/security/opasswd -p wa -k identity

          ## Sudo and privilege escalation
          -w /bin/su -p x -k priv_esc
          -w /usr/bin/sudo -p x -k priv_esc
          -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k priv_esc
          -w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k priv_esc

          ## Login/logout events
          -w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k logins

          ## Network/system identification
          -w /etc/issue -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/issue.net -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/hosts -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/sysconfig/network -p wa -k system-locale

          ## MAC policy changes (SELinux)
          -w /usr/share/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy

          ## Kernel module loading/unloading
          -w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -S delete_module -k modules

          ## Unsuccessful file access (permission denied)
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EPERM -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S open,openat,creat,truncate,ftruncate,unlink,unlinkat -F exit=-EPERM -k access

          ## Permission and ownership changes by regular users
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod

          ## Ensure auditing is enabled
          -e 1
      notify:
        - Load audit rules
        - Restart auditd

    - name: Ensure auditd is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: Reload sshd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: reloaded

    - name: Restart fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: Load audit rules
      ansible.builtin.command: augenrules --load

    - name: Restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted
